column1: # JSP counters (.jsp, .jspf, .jspx, tag files .tag and .tagx), for a rule with the prompt
# file-body-view: one per line, label TAB pattern (Java regex). The [ignore] line blanks JSP comments
# (<%-- --%>), which the container never sends, so a commented-out scriptlet or EL expression does
# not count; an HTML comment (<!-- -->) is sent to the browser and its <% %> still runs on the
# server, so it is kept. A JSP comment that is never closed runs to the end of the file. A directive
# counts in either syntax, <%@ page %> or the element <jsp:directive.page/> (include and attribute
# alike); a JSP document (.jspx, .tagx) takes jspx-facts, which blanks its XML comments. "scriptlets"
# counts <% blocks that are neither directives, expressions, declarations nor comments; "prefixed
# tags" every opening tag with a namespace prefix (JSTL, Spring form, custom tags); "request
# parameters read" both EL's param and getParameter in Java. ViewFactPatternsTest pins every case;
# ProfileFactPatternsLinearityTest measures that every pattern reads linearly.
